description: One mail message by Message-ID: headers, in_reply_to/references, decoded body text (by default the author's own words: quoted replies and their attributions, forwarded or Outlook-quoted mail, inline patches, diffstats and the signature removed; full_text=true for everything, quotes included), attachments [{index, filename, content_type, size}] and has_patch. quotes checks citations: each comes back with own_words (in the author's own text, whitespace-normalized) and in_message (anywhere, quoted text included); with include_body=false only the verdicts return. Never raw MIME: get_attachment returns an attachment's content, get_raw_message the RFC 822 source. Finds the list itself unless inbox is given. Cite as https://postgr.es/m/<message_id>.

body_only.description: Older spelling of full_text=true: the whole decoded text (default false).

full_text.description: Return the whole decoded text, quoted replies and signature included (default false: the author's own words only).

inbox.description: Mailing list name, e.g. pgsql-general. Defaults to pgsql-hackers when omitted. Aliases: list, inbox_name.

message_id.description: Message-ID (with or without angle brackets), or a message URL (postgr.es/m/..., postgresql.org/message-id/..., pg.ddx.io/m/...)

quotes.description: Up to 20 quotes to verify against this message: is each the author's own words (not text they quoted)? Under 12 characters is too_short.

name: get_message
